notes: EmbeddingGemma 2 Transcribe, LiteRT form: the audio encoder of google/embeddinggemma-2 (rev 914f7f89; Gemma 4 audio tower + embed_audio) exported to raw LiteRT graphs with an fp16-safe rewrite of its RMSNorm sites (per-site 2^-k rescale, eps x 4^-k, rsqrt clamp, attention mask -30000; bit-identical to the float32 model in fp32), fp16 weights (FLOAT_CASTING on FC / CONV_2D / DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D), one signature per file (audio_30s / audio_10s: mel float32 [1, F, 128] + mask -> soft tokens [1, F/4, 512] + mask), plus reader v2 (a 6-layer transformer over the soft tokens, 19,573,762 parameters, trained with CTC on LibriSpeech 960 h: mlboydaisuke/EmbeddingGemma-2-Transcribe-Reader revision de224fd8, reader.pt sha256 d605f6fb…; the 200,000-word table FC and ARG_MAX in-graph; reader v1's inputs, outputs and file names) = speech to words on the phone. This file: reader_w30.tflite (386726384 B), sha256 = hf_stage FILES.sha256 of the reader v2 upload set; every phone leg below ran these bytes (sha256 lines in the evidence). reader v2 for 30 s windows (T 750; the public script's output reader_v2_pub_w30.tflite: body float32, the word-table FC with the release's float16 rows behind a DEQUANTIZE, ARG_MAX int32 + REDUCE_MAX in-graph, 436 builtin ops). Pixel 8a through the sample app: the 54 min recording (round 12 hold 2) and the 9 fixtures of the 30 s pair in three 20-fixture runs (round 12 GPU fp32 / CPU with the r10b build, round 14 GPU fp32 with the r14 build). Reader v1's records of this file name are under 2.2.0/2026-10-14 (other bytes, artifact_sha256 76bdcce94e73…). Lane record: litertlm-convert eg2_stt_work (ROUND8, ROUND12, ROUND14; SPEED_LADDER.md rows 40–40d, 45–45d, 46–46b).
